channel.title: Finance
channel.description: Latest investing news and finance headlines straight from Wall Street.

item.title: How Nvidia turmoil and a Democratic Congress could reshape the AI trade, according to ETF experts
item.description: ETF experts say Nvidia’s leadership turmoil and Democratic control of Congress could shift AI demand to the benefit of other Big Tech stocks, rival chipmakers.

item.title: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home
item.description: Eric Trump-backed robot startup Foundation Future Industries has run low on cash and missed payroll, as CEO Sankaet Pathak faces scrutiny over a $4.6 million company loan.

item.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has deep ties to the chipmaker
item.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

item.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says central bank 'has definitely got work to do' on inflation
item.description: The policymaker expressed concern about the latest inflation data, telling CNBC that the central bank likely will need to take action.

item.title: How the Jensen Huang affair changes the outlook for U.S.-China relations
item.description: The political climate heading into next week's Trump-Xi summit is drastically different from the last meeting in September.

item.title: In a policy switch, the Fed says its October 2027 meeting will not see a vote on interest rates
item.description: There will be seven voting meetings next year, with the October session set up as extra time for policy deliberation without a formal vote or post-meeting statement.
